dialogues.speaker: Tournament Notice
dialogues.text: The exciting King of Invokations Grand Prix is in full swing! Many outstanding players have emerged from the competiton. Come participate in the duels today!

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: Huh, I didn't think you building designers could play cards so well. Quite a few players from Kshahrewar made it to the quarterfinals.

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: What do you mean, "building designers"? We study structural geometry and mechanism theory, and it's MUCH more complex than staring at words all day in Haravatat.

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Staring at words all day"? You should try "staring at words" a bit, maybe then you'd learn to write! Linguistics and Rune Studies are both extremely profound fields of knowledge.

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Everyone has their specialties. But since nobody is willing to yield, why don't we organize an Interdarshan Invokation Championship?

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: I'll see you at the tournament!
